segments.en: I've caught a message.

An organization called GEAR
is asking for an alliance.

Do you know where
we should go?

Um...
Probably here...
I'll put up a marker now.

Here on the Asia Continent,
Lord Arthea has been dispatched
by the Galfa Empire.

Join up with Lord Arthea's unit
at once and conquer the
Asia Continent.

Lord Arthea's fleet is currently
using a Grados Army base as
its home port.

If we go to the Grados Supply Base,
we should be able to make contact.
Showing the marker.

We've arrived at the
designated spot.

Lun...
This is the right place, isn't it?
I've caught a transmission.
Patching it through now.
This is GEAR Headquarters.

We'll guide you in,
so please land.
Understood.

Beginning our landing
approach now.
Welcome to GEAR Headquarters!
I am Commander Shibuya.

Thank you for so readily
accepting our alliance.

From now on, let's join
forces and fight together!

The pleasure is ours.
We look forward to working
with you!
Alliance formed with GEAR.

The unit "Dendoh" is now
available.

The battleship "Meteor" is now
available.

The warrior "Vega" has been
assigned to you.

The five "Samurai Troopers"
have been assigned to you.
I'm Vega, the vice commander.
I'll now explain the operation.

The operation area is the northern
Asia Continent:
the "Grados Supply Base."

Take this base, and the
Asia Continent will be liberated.
I see...
So, what about our forces?

GEAR intends to commit "Dendoh"
to the operation.

We also have collaborators
in Paradigm City.

If you want to strengthen your
forces, join up with them.

The target is the "Grados Supply
Base," and going via Paradigm City
will get us reinforcements, right?
Understood.
We'll do our very best.

<Operation Launched>
Grados Supply Base Assault

rows.notes: [jp] -> Samurai Troopers (form used in other slices). [jp] -> <Operation Launched>, bracket style as <Win Condition>. | [editorial 5] system-message template unified

segments.en:
Joined up with the collaborators
in Paradigm City.

The ship "Bebop" is now
available.

The units "Swordfish" and
"Red Tail" are now available.

The unit "Big O" is now
available.

rows.notes: [jp] kept as 'Swordfish' as written (the unit is Swordfish II in the glossary).

segments.en:
Yo!
So you're this Omega guy?

Ah, no...
It's not me...
Figured as much...

So you're the one who's
supposed to be useful?

Long as you set me up with
fair pay and a machine
I can actually use.

Very well. You can show me
what you're worth in real combat.

All right!
We've got ourselves a deal!
Beck has been hired.

We have been awaiting you,
Lord Redros.
All is ready for you to dock.

At last the Galfa Empire and the
Redros Army will form a true
united front.

To begin, let us conquer the
Asia Continent and offer it
to Emperor Galfa as a gift.
As you command!

Are preparations for the
operation in order?
Yes.

The enemy's stronghold
is already laid bare...

We can launch the assault
at a moment's notice.
Joined up with Black Knight Arthea.
The Ouga joins your forces.

<Operation Launched>
GEAR HQ Assault

rows.notes: [jp] -> Emperor Galfa (glossary). [jp]: reading dropped, Ouga per glossary. | [editorial 9] stray slash from the source; name as in the speaker header

segments.en:
Entering combat with the
GEAR main force.

Air superiority over
GEAR HQ secured.

An infantry squad must be sent in
to take the ground.
Send in the Infantry Squad?

Attack now
Attack later
Sending in the Infantry Squad.

The ground assault will be
carried out later.

rows.notes: [editorial 5] 'The ground will be taken later' was unclear

segments.en: Commencing the infantry assault.

rows.notes: Source [jp] is ungrammatical (squad + 'begin'); rendered as the evident meaning.

segments.en: The ground has been secured.

You can now dock at
Hoshimi Town.
The battle will now begin.

Air superiority over the
Grados Supply Base secured.

An infantry squad must be sent in
to take the ground.
Send in the Infantry Squad?

Attack now
Attack later
Sending in the Infantry Squad.

The ground assault will be
carried out later.
Sending in the Infantry Squad.
The ground has been secured.
You can now dock at the base.
An emergency transmission?
It's from GEAR Headquarters!

An enemy fleet made a surprise
attack on Paradigm City! It looks
like they've taken the city!

I'm sending the data.
Lun, please analyze it.
Roger!

Why would they go for Paradigm
City and not GEAR HQ...?

'Cause there's a gate leading to
space near that city...

Then...
the enemy is the Redros Army?
Analysis complete.

The enemy appears to be a mixed
force of the Redros Army and
the Grados Army.
I knew it!
At this rate...

We're retaking Paradigm City!
Hurry and prepare to depart!

<Operation Launched>
Paradigm City Recapture

rows.notes: Seg 12: Vega's line is cut off by Rie; kept unfinished. | [editorial 7] line answers Rie's 'why'; the causal link was lost

segments.en: The battle will now begin.

rows.notes: [accuracy 0] project decision: [jp] = 'The battle will now begin.' (66 uses corpus-wide)

segments.en: The enemy fleet is withdrawing.
All ships, cease fire.

Do not pursue. Switch over
to resupply operations.

Transmission from the
Paradigm Corporation.

Probably the Paradigm Corporation's
president, Alex Rosewater...
Connecting now.

I am Alex Rosewater of the
Paradigm Corporation.

I am deeply impressed by
your forces' work.

On behalf of Paradigm City,
I thank you from the
bottom of my heart.

From now on, Paradigm City wishes
to establish friendly relations
with your forces.

The Paradigm Corporation will
also support you with all
its might.
Thank you very much.

If we may, could you let us dock
to resupply right away?

Ha ha!
By all means!

The airport will always be
open for you.
What... was that...

They've barely lifted a finger
to help GEAR until now...

They saw we had the upper hand
and switched sides just like that.

...Somehow,
that doesn't sit right with me...
Yeah...
Paradigm City has been retaken.

You can now dock at
Paradigm City.

rows.notes: Seg 16: dropped subject restored as 'They' (the Paradigm Corporation / Rosewater's side). [jp] -> president (glossary position). | [editorial 13] 'You're most welcome' read as a reply to thanks; daikangei answers the docking request | [editorial 17] tense agreement

segments.en:
I'm Major Dan Dastun of
the Military Police.

On orders from above, I'll be
accompanying this fleet.
We've been informed.

We look forward to working
with you.

Nice to meet ya,
old man!

Ha!
Same to you, kid!

Paradigm Corporation president
Alex Rosewater has once again
expressed his gratitude.

From now on, you'll have the
cooperation of Paradigm City's
Military Police.

The vehicle "Military Police
Armored Car" is now available.

rows.notes: Seg 5: [jp] rendered 'Ha!' as a hearty reply.
